description: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across different medical specialties, comparing the performance of various models. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "Per-specialty terms," with six distinct categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and has a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Each category on the horizontal axis is associated with a group of six bars, representing different specialties, colored according to the legend: Cardio (light orange), Gastro (peach), Infect (dark orange), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (dark brown), and Pediatrics (tan), with a blue bar representing the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, and their heights vary, with the blue "Mistralv0.2-Base" bar being the tallest in all categories except Cardio, where it is the shortest, with a value of approximately -26.5, while the other bars in the Cardio category range from around -22 to -23. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within their groups, and the "Mistralv0.2-Base" bar is visually distinct due to its blue color.
